title.en: On-street EV charging in UK is postcode lottery as drivers face council objections
title.zh: 英国街头电动汽车充电设施成“邮政编码彩票”，司机面临地方议会反对

summary.en: More than 20 local authorities in the UK are refusing to allow on-street electric vehicle (EV) charging gullies, despite government pledges to expand infrastructure. Councils cite safety, legal, and parking concerns, creating a "postcode lottery" for drivers.
summary.zh: 尽管政府承诺扩大基础设施，英国有20多个地方政府拒绝允许在街道上安装电动汽车（EV）充电沟槽。地方议会援引安全、法律和停车方面的担忧，为司机造成了“邮政编码彩票”的局面。

body.en: Despite government pledges, more than 20 authorities will not allow gullies, citing safety, legal and parking concerns The energy secretary, Ed Miliband, has said charger gullies to connect electric cars parked on streets will help cut costs for drivers, yet millions of UK households may be unable to use the simple technology because their local councils will still not allow charging cables to cross the pavement. Despite government promises to “slash red tape” and make it easier to put in gullies, more than 20 local authorities appear to be holding out against them. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管政府做出承诺，但仍有 20 多个当局以安全、法律和停车问题为由，不允许修建集水沟。能源大臣埃德·米利班德 (Ed Miliband) 表示，连接停放在街道上的电动汽车的充电集水沟将有助于降低司机的成本，但数百万英国家庭可能无法使用这项简单的技术，因为当地议会仍然不允许充电电缆穿过人行道。尽管政府承诺“削减繁文缛节”并让修建沟渠变得更容易，但 20 多个地方当局似乎仍坚持反对。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The challenge of implementing national policies, like EV charging, often highlights the need for diverse perspectives. When local authorities raise valid concerns despite government pledges, it underscores the wisdom in seeking "many advisers" to ensure effective and equitable solutions for all citizens. This collaborative approach helps navigate complex...
reflection.zh: 国家政策的实施，例如电动汽车充电设施的建设，常常凸显出采纳多方意见的重要性。当地方政府对中央承诺提出合理异议时，这强调了“谋士众多”的智慧，以确保为所有公民提供有效和公平的解决方案。这种协作方式有助于解决复杂问题并避免不一致的结果。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Manchester cafe owner says police tried to recruit him to spy on Palestine Action
title.zh: 曼彻斯特咖啡馆老板称警方试图招募他监视“巴勒斯坦行动”

summary.en: A cafe owner in Manchester claims police officers offered him financial benefits and to ignore minor offenses if he agreed to inform on the activist group Palestine Action.
summary.zh: 曼彻斯特一家咖啡馆的老板声称，如果他同意告发“巴勒斯坦行动”组织，警方官员曾向他提供经济利益并承诺对某些轻微违法行为视而不见。

body.en: Exclusive: Shams Sadiq says officers offered financial inducements and to turn a ‘blind eye’ to certain offences A cafe owner claims police offered him financial benefits and to turn a “blind eye” to certain low-level offences if he informed on Palestine Action. Shams (his nickname) Sadiq, who owns two Manchester cafes, said the inducements were offered when he went to collect electronic devices that police had confiscated during his arrest last year in connection with alleged offences relating to the banned direct action group . Continue reading...

reflection.en: The news of authorities allegedly offering inducements and overlooking offenses to gain an informant raises serious questions about integrity. Proverbs 16:12 reminds us that righteous rule is the foundation of stable authority, and that evil acts by those in power are an abomination. This incident underscores the vital importance of ethical conduct and...
reflection.zh: 警方被指控为招募线人而提供好处并对某些违法行为视而不见，这引发了对公权力诚信的严重质疑。箴言16:12提醒我们，公义的统治是权威的根基，掌权者行恶是可憎的。这起事件强调了所有掌握公共信任的人都必须遵守道德行为和问责制。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Eighteen people killed in Afghanistan truck crash, including 10 children
title.zh: 阿富汗卡车坠毁致18人死亡，其中包括10名儿童

summary.en: Eighteen people, including 10 children, were killed when a truck carrying Afghan families returning from Pakistan overturned in eastern Afghanistan. Deadly traffic crashes are common in the region.
summary.zh: 一辆载有从巴基斯坦返回的阿富汗家庭的卡车在阿富汗东部倾覆，造成18人死亡，其中包括10名儿童。该地区致命的交通事故屡见不鲜。

body.en:
A truck overturned in eastern Afghanistan on Saturday, killing 18 people on board including 10 children, a provincial official told Agence France-Presse.

Deadly traffic crashes are common in Afghanistan, due in part to poor roads after decades of conflict, dangerous driving and a lack of regulation.

The vehicle was carrying Afghan families returning from Pakistan, where they had been living, according to Abdul Malik Niazay, spokesperson for the governor of Laghman province.

“Eighteen people (have died), including 10 children, five women and three men. In addition, 29 people have been injured,” the spokesperson said.

The accident happened on the road between Jalalabad in eastern Afghanistan and the capital Kabul.

Authorities in Pakistan have toughened their stance on Afghan migrants and refugees in their country – causing an outflow that often includes families travelling with their belongings in trucks.

Since the start of the year, 447,400 Afghans have returned from Pakistan, according to figures from the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees and the International Organization for Migration.

Last August, a collision between a bus carrying Afghan migrants returning from Iran and two other vehicles in western Afghanistan killed 78 people , including 19 children.
body.zh: 一名省级官员告诉法新社，周六，一辆卡车在阿富汗东部翻覆，造成车上 18 人死亡，其中包括 10 名儿童。 致命的交通事故在阿富汗很常见，部分原因是几十年冲突后道路状况不佳、危险驾驶和缺乏监管。 拉格曼省省长发言人阿卜杜勒·马利克·尼亚扎伊 (Abdul Malik Niazay) 表示，这辆车载着从巴基斯坦返回的阿富汗家庭，他们一直居住在巴基斯坦。 “有 18 人死亡，其中包括 10 名儿童、5 名妇女和 3 名男子。此外，还有 29 人受伤，”发言人说。 事故发生在阿富汗东部贾拉拉巴德与首都喀布尔之间的公路上。 巴基斯坦当局对本国境内的阿富汗移民和难民采取了强硬立场，导致难民外流，其中往往包括带着财物用卡车出行的家庭。 根据联合国难民事务高级专员和国际移民组织的数据，自今年年初以来，已有 447,400 名阿富汗人从巴基斯坦返回。 去年8月，一辆载有从伊朗返回的阿富汗移民的巴士与另外两辆汽车在阿富汗西部发生碰撞，造成78人死亡，其中包括19名儿童。

reflection.en: The tragic loss of life, especially so many children, in this accident brings profound sorrow. In moments of such deep grief, we hold onto the promise that one day, all tears will be wiped away, and pain will be no more. This hope reminds us that suffering is not the final word.
reflection.zh: 这起事故中生命的悲剧性逝去，特别是这么多儿童的离世，带来了深切的悲痛。在如此深重的哀伤时刻，我们紧紧抓住那应许，有一天，所有的眼泪都将被擦去，痛苦将不复存在。这个盼望提醒我们，苦难并非最终的结局。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: First diver freed from Laos cave as rescue mission intensifies
title.zh: 老挝洞穴救援任务加剧，首名潜水员获救

summary.en: A specialist diving crew from around the world have arrived in Laos to help retrieve the other trapped men.
summary.zh: 来自世界各地的专业潜水员已抵达老挝，协助营救其他被困人员。

body.en:
A rescue team freed on Friday one of seven men trapped inside a semi-submerged cave in Laos for more than a week, the group working at the site said.

The seven men had been trapped in the cavern in a remote mountainous area of central Xaysomboun province since 20 May, when flash floods stranded them while they were searching for gold, early state media reports said.

Five of the men were located alive on Wednesday, huddling in a narrow shaft around 300 metres from the cave mouth.

Footage filmed by rescue divers showed them muddy and despondent, complaining of chest pains and hunger pangs, while the remaining two of their group remain unaccounted for.

"The first victim has been successfully rescued out of the cave," a Thai rescue group said in a Facebook post late Friday, accompanied by a picture of three men guiding another bedraggled and muddy man over unsteady ground.

Rescue efforts had focused on pumping out the monsoon floodwaters that trapped the men.

"One person has got out of the cave safely," Thai rescue team member Kengkard Bonggawong said in a separate Facebook post.

Earlier in the day, Thai rescue teams were rehearsing extraction procedures outside the cave with stretchers, ropes and cables, according to images shared on social media.

Laos's meteorology office forecast thunderstorms on Friday afternoon and evening, with rainfall expected across 60 per cent of Xaysomboun province.

Meanwhile, a new team of specialist divers touched down in Laos on Friday, including members from Thailand, France, Indonesia and Australia, according to Thai rescuers.

The emergency echoes the 2018 case of the Thai youth football team, which spent 18 days trapped in a cave in Thailand's north before a daring international rescue saved their lives.

Two divers involved in that retrieval of 12 young footballers and their coach are working with Laotian volunteers after locals requested specialist personnel and equipment.

Finnish diver Mikko Paasi, part of the team that saved the 'Wild Boars' football team in Thailand, said on Wednesday that rescuers were "racing against time" inside the cave.

Rain the following day sent more soil and water into the cave, according to a Laotian logistics staffer for a firm supplying vehicles to support the rescue operation.

The man said on Thursday the rescue operation could stretch to "a few more days" if rains continued, speaking on condition of anonymity due to fears of reprisal from his employer.

body.zh: 在现场工作的救援小组称，周五，一支救援队解救了被困在老挝一个半水下洞穴内一周多的七名男子中的一名。 官方媒体早期报道称，自 5 月 20 日起，这七名男子在寻找黄金时遭遇山洪，被困在赛宋本省中部偏远山区的洞穴中。 周三，其中五名男子被发现还活着，他们蜷缩在距洞口约 300 米的狭窄竖井中。 救援潜水员拍摄的视频显示，他们浑身泥泞、沮丧，抱怨胸痛和饥饿感，而剩下的两人仍然下落不明。 周五晚些时候，泰国一个救援组织在脸书上发帖称，“第一名受害者已被成功救出洞穴”，并附上一张三名男子引导另一名浑身泥泞的男子走过不稳定地面的照片。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 救援工作的重点是抽出被困人员的季风洪水。 泰国救援队成员肯卡德·邦加旺（Kengkard Bonggawong）在脸书上发帖称：“一人已安全逃离洞穴。” 根据社交媒体上分享的图片，当天早些时候，泰国救援队正在洞穴外用担架、绳索和缆绳演练救援程序。 老挝气象局预计周五下午和晚上将有雷暴，赛宋本省 60% 的地区将出现降雨。 与此同时，据泰国救援人员称，一支新的专业潜水员队伍于周五在老挝着陆，其中包括来自泰国、法国、印度尼西亚和澳大利亚的成员。 这次紧急情况与 2018 年泰国青年足球队的案例相呼应，该队被困在泰国北部的一个山洞里 18 天，直到一次大胆的国际救援才挽救了他们的生命。 在当地人请求专业人员和设备后，参与救回 12 名年轻足球运动员的两名潜水员及其教练正在与老挝志愿者合作。 芬兰跳水运动员米科·帕西 (Mikko Paasi) 是拯救泰国“野猪”足球队的队员，他周三表示，救援人员正在洞穴内“与时间赛跑”。 一家为救援行动提供车辆的老挝公司的一名后勤人员表示，第二天的降雨使更多的土壤和水进入了洞穴。 该男子周四表示，如果降雨继续，救援行动可能会持续“几天”，由于担心雇主报复，该男子要求匿名。 老挝当地媒体报道称，几名救援人员在携带氧气罐、救援设备和物品在洞穴系统内待了七到十个小时后，出现了疲惫的迹象。

reflection.en: The news of the first diver's rescue brings a wave of relief and hope amidst a harrowing ordeal. It reminds us that even after long nights of fear and uncertainty, moments of joy and breakthrough can emerge. This initial success fuels prayers and efforts for the safe return of all still trapped.
reflection.zh: 首名潜水员获救的消息，在严峻的困境中带来了宽慰与希望。它提醒我们，即使在漫长的恐惧和不确定之夜后，喜悦和突破的时刻也会到来。这一初步的成功，激励着人们为所有被困者安全归来而祈祷和努力。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: Resident group’s objections to bar and restaurant licences ‘destroying Soho’s reputation’
title.zh: 居民团体反对酒吧和餐厅执照，“正在摧毁苏荷区的声誉”

summary.en: A residents' group in London's Soho district is fiercely opposing all new proposals for bar and restaurant licenses, leading venue owners to claim this could damage Soho's international reputation as an entertainment hub. The group, funded by the Westminster council, is accused of destroying the area's character.
summary.zh: 伦敦苏荷区的一个居民团体强烈反对所有新的酒吧和餐厅执照申请，导致场所业主声称这可能会损害苏荷区作为国际娱乐中心的声誉。这个由威斯敏斯特市议会资助的团体被指控正在破坏该地区的特色。

body.en: Soho Society, funded by Westminster council, is ferociously opposing all new proposals, venue owners say A society of residents funded by the council could “destroy Soho’s reputation on the international stage” as London’s entertainment district by ferociously objecting to all new bar and restaurant licences, operators in the area have said. The Soho Society, a group of residents established in 1972 aimed at “preserving the character of Soho”, voted in its AGM on Thursday for a new licensing mandate, meaning it will challenge all new applications for bars and restaurants in the area, including renewals of existing licences. It will also object to any venue that wishes to open beyond “core hours”, which Westminster council decrees end at 11pm. Continue reading...

title.en: US not 'turning back' on Asia allies, but expects them to boost defence - Hegseth
title.zh: 美国不会“背弃”亚洲盟友，但期望他们加强防卫——赫格塞思

summary.en: The US defense secretary, at an Asian security summit in Singapore, affirmed US commitment to its allies but also stated an expectation for them to increase their defense capabilities, including through further arms deals.
summary.zh: 美国国防部长在新加坡举行的亚洲安全峰会上，重申了美国对其亚洲盟友的承诺，但也表示期望盟友们能加强自身防卫能力，包括通过进一步的军火交易。

body.en:
The US military are not "turning our backs" on Asia while fulfilling "global obligations" such as the Iran war, US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has told a top regional defence forum in Singapore.

Hegseth sought to reassure Asia-Pacific allies about US commitment to the region, including fulfilling arms deals in the wake of a suspended Taiwan weapons package - even as he reiterated calls for Asian partners to spend more on defence.

While noting the threat of China's military build-up in the region, Hegseth also said the US wanted to avoid "needless confrontation".

Hegseth was speaking weeks after Donald Trump held positive talks with ​China's President Xi Jinping in Beijing.

At the Shangri-La Dialogue on Saturday, Hegseth was asked by Japan's defence minister to address concerns about US commitment. Shinjiro Koizumi said "some countries might underestimate" that level of commitment and may want to "drive a wedge" between the US and its allies.

Hegseth replied that part of the US national defence strategy was aimed at "power projection" in the Pacific and working with allies.

"People want to conflate that we have global obligations with the turning of our backs to this region," he said, denying that was the case.

"We can do two things at one time," he insisted, saying the US was "quietly but very strongly" working with allies with a "substantive, serious approach" to the Pacific, while maintaining "global obligations to ensure that, say, Iran doesn't get a nuclear weapon".

Separately, a dialogue participant raised the question of the US's ability to fulfil arms deals with its partners after suspending a $14bn (£10bn) package to Taiwan in order to conserve munitions for the war in Iran.

Hegseth said he would "very much decouple the two" issues, insisting the US was in a "very good place... very strong position" in terms of its overall munitions stockpile and ability to produce more if needed.

In his speech, Hegseth emphasised the US's "strong, quiet and clear" approach to the region - its capacity to wield a "big stick" but "speak softly".

Central to this approach was more weapons, he insisted, instead of "empty globalist rhetoric about the rules-based international order".

"Rules are great, but if you can't back them up with hard power, the rules are not worth the paper they are written on," he said. "We don't need more conferences, we need more combat power… less Shangri-La Dialogue, more ships and more subs."

His comments came hours after Vietnam's President To Lam called for more dialogue to resolve tensions in the region, in the defence summit's keynote speech.

Reiterating a demand which he made in last year's speech, Hegseth called on Asian allies to spend more on defence, setting 3.5% of their GDP as a target.

title.en: Pete Hegseth warns Chinese military threatens 'balance of power' in the Pacific
title.zh: 皮特·赫格塞斯警告中国军队威胁太平洋“力量平衡”

summary.en: Pete Hegseth warned US allies that the Chinese military poses a threat to the balance of power in the Pacific, emphasizing the need for partners rather than protectorates.
summary.zh: 皮特·赫格塞斯警告美国盟友，中国军队对太平洋地区的“力量平衡”构成威胁，并强调美国需要“伙伴而非被保护国”。

body.en:
United States Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth has urged Asian allies to ramp up military spending to counter China's growing power and prevent its dominance in the region.

Hegseth has warned about China's rapid military buildup at the during a speech at the Shangri-La Dialogue, Asia's premier forum for defence leaders, militaries and diplomats, that is taking place in Singapore this weekend.

Hegseth said a stronger, more self-reliant network of allies is essential to deter aggression and preserve the balance of power.

"There is rightful alarm regarding China's historic military buildup and the expansion of its military activities in the region and beyond," he said.

"A Pacific dominated by any hegemon would unravel the regional balance of power," Hegseth said.

"No state, including China, can impose its hegemony and hold the security or prosperity of our nation and our allies in question."

The US expects its Asian allies and partners to increase defence spending to 3.5 per cent of GDP as it pledged a $1.5 trillion investment in its military, the Pentagon chief said.

"What they want, and what the US delivers, is strength that is disciplined, resolve that is steady, and leadership that is confident enough to speak and walk softly while carrying a big stick."

Hegseth also struck a measured tone on US-China ties, saying relations are "better than they have been in many years," with more frequent military-to-military engagement helping to manage tensions.

"We are meeting more frequently with our Chinese counterparts by maintaining open lines of military-to-military communication," he said.

Hegseth echoed President Donald Trump's long-standing demand that allies should shoulder more of their own defence costs. Trump has pointedly said European and NATO partners should reduce reliance on Washington.

"The era of the United States subsidising the defence of wealthy nations is over," Hegseth said.

"We don't have a strong alliance unless everyone has skin in the game. No freeloading."

Hegseth praised contributions from allies including South Korea, the Philippines, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand, and said Japan was taking concrete steps to bolster its defences.

He said Japan and the US "must each pull our weight" to strengthen their alliance.

Asked about arms sales to Taiwan, Hegseth downplayed concerns that a multi-billion-dollar package could be affected as the US draws down its weapons stockpiles amid the Middle East conflict.

Taiwan, which China views as its own territory, has been waiting for the US to approve an arms sale that could be worth up to US$14 billion ($20 billion).

title.en: US to restart attacks on Iran if ceasefire deal fails
title.zh: 美国若停火协议失败将重启对伊朗的袭击

summary.en: The US announced it was close to a ceasefire agreement with Iran following Friday's negotiations, but warned that attacks would resume if the deal collapses. The report also highlighted the obstacles hindering the agreement.
summary.zh: 美国表示，在周五的谈判后，与伊朗达成停火协议在即，但警告称如果协议失败，将重启对伊朗的袭击。报道还指出了阻碍协议达成的障碍。

body.en:
The US is prepared to restart attacks on Iran if an agreement cannot be reached, despite negotiators from both nations work to bridge major differences blocking an agreement.

"Our ability to recommence if necessary...we are more than capable," Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth said in Singapore on Saturday.

"Our stockpiles are more than suited for that, both there and around the globe, so we're in a very good place," he added.

Speaking at the Shangri-La Dialogue, the Pentagon chief said President Donald Trump was "patient" and wants to make a "great deal" that ensures Iran does not get a nuclear weapon.

On Friday, Trump said he would meet in a secure White House room to make a "final determination" on a proposal to end the Iran war.

The agreement would extend an early-April truce for another 60 days, giving negotiators time to forge a permanent end to the conflict. However, both countries still appeared to differ on significant issues central to the conflict.

A White House official said the meeting in the Situation Room lasted about two hours, but did not address whether Trump had made a decision.

A senior Iranian source told Reuters an agreement was close but had not yet been approved.

Trump also said Iran would have to end its chokehold on the Strait of Hormuz and dismantle its capacity to make a nuclear weapon — two conditions that Tehran has not agreed to.

An agreement would represent a big step towards ending a war that has pushed the world towards an energy crisis, though the underlying dispute over Iran's nuclear program would only be thrashed out in talks over subsequent weeks.

Following a ceasefire in early April, the two sides have remained at odds on issues including Iran's nuclear ambitions, Israel's war in Lebanon with the Iranian-backed Hezbollah militia, and Tehran's demands for the lifting of sanctions and the release of frozen assets.

After weeks of mainly indirect talks, four sources familiar with the matter said on Thursday that the US and Iran had agreed on a memorandum of understanding that would halt the war and give negotiators 60 days to reach a final deal.

However, both sides have said several times before that they believed an agreement was close, but none has been reached. The position of Israel, which launched the war on Iran on 28 February alongside the US, is central to any deal, but its role in the agreement is unclear.

Trump has not yet approved the deal, according to the sources. Vice President JD Vance said on Thursday: "We're not there, but we're very close and we're going to keep working on it".

title.zh: 特朗普会晤后未宣布与伊朗达成协议，以做出“最终决定”

summary.en: The US president met with his advisors to make a "final determination" regarding a potential deal with Iran. This meeting followed confirmation from officials that a framework for an agreement had been reached between the two nations, but no final deal was announced.
summary.zh: 美国总统与顾问会晤，就与伊朗可能达成的协议做出“最终决定”。此前，官员证实美伊两国已就协议框架达成一致，但会后并未宣布最终协议。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump had a meeting with top aides on Friday to make a "final determination" about a framework for extending the ceasefire with Iran, but it concluded without clarity on the next steps.

He said Iran must agree to never have a nuclear weapon or bomb, that the Strait of Hormuz be reopened for "unrestricted shipping traffic, in both directions", and that any mines in the waterway are "destroyed".

The meeting was held in the White House's Situation Room, used for dealing with major crises. Iran earlier said it was not negotiating on its nuclear programme - which it insists is wholly for civilian purposes.

On Thursday, the two countries had agreed a framework of a deal - known as a memorandum of understanding - pending the approval of Trump and Iran's leadership, according to US officials.

The deal would reportedly extend the ceasefire for 60 days and launch talks on the future of Iran's nuclear programme.

"President Trump will only make a deal that is good for America and satisfies his red lines. Iran can never possess a nuclear weapon," a White House official told CBS News, the BBC's US news partner.

Since the ceasefire came into effect on 8 April, Trump has repeatedly suggested the US and Iran are close to a deal and negotiations are progressing, but so far there have been no substantive results.

In a social media post earlier on Friday, Trump said he was prepared to lift the US naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, allowing ships caught in the waterway to "start the process of 'heading home!'"

He also insisted that Iran allow the US to remove and destroy its enriched uranium.

"No money will be exchanged, until further notice," he said. "Other items, of far less importance, have been agreed to."

Later, a White House official confirmed to the BBC that the meeting in the Situation Room had concluded. The official provided no further details.

Iran's Fars news agency cited informed sources as saying that Trump's latest comments were a "mixture of truth and lies".

There was no provision to destroy nuclear materials in the memorandum of understanding, the agency reported.

Meanwhile, Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei told state TV it was "focused on ending the war, and there are no negotiations on the nuclear issue".

The US has long demanded that Iran stop producing highly enriched uranium and dispose of its existing stockpile, which in theory could be used to create nuclear weapons.

Iran says its nuclear programme is entirely peaceful and denies it is seeking to develop nuclear weapons.

The possibility of the US being able to "recommence" strikes in Iran was floated by US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth.

title.en: Move over, Heated Rivalry - there's a new ice hockey romance obsession
title.zh: 告别《激烈竞争》，冰球浪漫剧成为新宠

summary.en: The Amazon Prime adaptation of Elle Kennedy's ice hockey romance book is an early hit with viewers.
summary.zh: 亚马逊Prime改编的艾丽·肯尼迪冰球浪漫小说迅速走红，吸引了众多观众，引发了广泛的粉丝兴趣。

body.en:
If you thought you'd had your fill of ice hockey romance for the year, then think again.

First came surprise hit Heated Rivalry, a Canadian series which arrived on streaming in the UK in January and led to global fame for its stars Hudson Williams and Connor Storrie.

And in the last few weeks, Amazon Prime released Off Campus, another adaptation of an ice hockey romance book, which the streamer says has instantly become its top show worldwide.

Based on the series by Canadian author Elle Kennedy, which sold 25 million copies, the show has been praised by fans for its portrayal of female desire, its emotionally intelligent male characters and, of course, its high-stakes sports action.

The show follows the sex lives and romantic dramas of college ice hockey players at a fictional Boston university.

Book content creator Meagan Carioti, 27, says "hockey is a hot, passionate sport" which "translates really well into romance", thanks to its intensity.

Social media manager and ice hockey enthusiast Sophie Bonser, 30, thinks interest in ice hockey from outside North America is partly due to a novelty that stems from people not having grown up playing the sport.

The show's male characters - Garrett Graham (played by 28-year-old Belmont Cameli), Dean Di Laurentis (played by 28-year-old Stephen Kalyn) and John Logan (played by 26-year-old Antonio Cipriano) - don't fall into the typical "jock" stereotypes viewers may be used to seeing in sports dramas.

Off Campus references the derogatory slang "puck bunny", which is used to describe female ice hockey fans who are more interested in the players than the game itself.

But there is an emphasis in the show on ice hockey players wanting to respect women, rather than use them.

The first series of the show is adapted from two of Elle Kennedy's books - The Deal and The Score - which were first released in 2015 and 2016.

Some of the show's scenes have been praised by female fans for depicting male characters showing care about women's sexual satisfaction.

Meagan says it is "so powerful" to see "women's pleasure and comfort talked about, prioritised and valued" in a TV show but feels this isn't common enough.

"I love men written by women, the yearning is just unmatched and it's the female gaze - what women want - I think [it] is different to what men think women want," she adds.

Content creator Oliver Zane, 25, whose Off Campus reaction videos have amassed hundreds of thousands of views on TikTok, tells the BBC he's a "sucker for girly TV shows", even though he's "not the primary audience".

"Female writers do such a good job with character development, which makes them more realistic," he says.

He says the way women are prioritised in the show "is such a draw" and he enjoyed watching Off Campus as it gave...
body.zh: 如果您认为今年的冰球浪漫已经够了，那么请再想一想。 首先是出人意料的热播《激烈竞争》，这是一部加拿大剧集，于 1 月份在英国播出，主演哈德森·威廉姆斯和康纳·斯托里因此享誉全球。 在过去的几周里，亚马逊 Prime 发布了另一部改编自冰球浪漫小说的《Off Campus》，该流媒体称该剧立即成为其全球顶级节目。 该剧改编自加拿大作家艾丽·肯尼迪的连续剧，销量达 2500 万册，因其对女性欲望的刻画、高情商的男性角色，当然还有高风险的体育动作而受到粉丝的好评。 该剧讲述了虚构的波士顿大学冰球运动员的性生活和浪漫故事。 27 岁的图书内容创作者梅根·卡里奥蒂 (Meagan Carioti) 表示，“曲棍球是一项热门、充满激情的运动”，由于其强度，“可以很好地转化为浪漫”。 30 岁的社交媒体经理兼冰球爱好者索菲·邦瑟 (Sophie Bonser) 认为，北美以外地区对冰球的兴趣部分是由于那些从小就没有玩过这项运动的人所带来的新鲜感。 该剧的男性角色——加勒特·格雷厄姆（由 28 岁的贝尔蒙特·卡梅利饰演）、迪恩·迪·劳伦蒂斯（由 28 岁的斯蒂芬·卡林饰演）和约翰·洛根（由 26 岁的安东尼奥·西普里亚诺饰演）——并不属于观众在体育剧中常见的典型“运动员”刻板印象。 Off Campus 引用了贬义俚语“puck bunny”，用来形容对冰球运动员比比赛本身更感兴趣的女冰球迷。 但该剧强调冰球运动员想要尊重女性，而不是利用她们。 该剧的第一季改编自艾丽·肯尼迪 (Elle Kennedy) 的两本书《交易》(The Deal) 和《分数》(The Score)，这两本书分别于 2015 年和 2016 年首次发行。 该剧的一些场景因描绘男性角色关心女性性满足而受到女性粉丝的称赞。 梅根表示，在电视节目中看到“女性的快乐和舒适被谈论、优先考虑和重视”是“非常有力的”，但她觉得这还不够普遍。 “我喜欢女人写的男人，这种渴望是无与伦比的，这是女性的目光——女人想要的——我认为[它]与男人认为女人想要的不同，”她补充道。 25 岁的内容创作者奥利弗·赞恩 (Oliver Zane) 的校外反应视频在 TikTok 上获得了数十万次观看，他告诉 BBC，他“很喜欢少女电视节目”，尽管他“不是主要观众”。 “女作家在人物塑造方面做得非常好，这使得她们更加现实，”他说。 他说，这部剧中女性优先的方式“非常吸引人”，他很喜欢观看《校外》，因为它给了……

reflection.en: The rapid rise of a new entertainment obsession highlights how easily our affections can be captured by stories and trends. While enjoying popular culture is natural, this reminds us to be mindful of what truly holds our hearts and attention. We are called to guard our hearts against anything that might subtly displace our ultimate devotion.
reflection.zh: 一部新的娱乐作品迅速走红，成为人们追捧的对象，这凸显了我们的情感多么容易被故事和潮流所吸引。虽然享受流行文化是自然的，但这提醒我们要留意什么真正占据了我们的心和注意力。我们被呼召要警惕任何可能悄然取代我们最终忠诚的事物。

verse.textEn: Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.

title.en: 'Gifts' from a lover and 'botched' cocaine raids: Police inquiry grips South Africa
title.zh: “情人”的“礼物”和“拙劣”的可卡因突袭：南非警方调查引人关注

summary.en: South Africa's Madlanga Commission hears about Brazilian butt lift bribe denials and alleged drug heists.
summary.zh: 南非马德兰加委员会正在审理关于巴西提臀术贿赂否认和涉嫌毒品盗窃的案件。

body.en:
An investigation into alleged police corruption in South Africa has had the nation captivated - much like the second season of a successful Netflix crime drama.

What could be regarded as the first season of this real-life inquiry into allegations made by a senior officer last July - that organised crime groups had infiltrated the police and government - ran from September to December. The revelations included details of an alleged drug cartel and named those at the heart of the alleged corruption .

The "second season" of this inquiry has just wrapped up - with another interim report on the proceedings handed over to President Cyril Ramaphosa on Friday.

Like the first interim report from the Madlanga Commission, it was not made public, though the contents are likely to be fairly explosive - if the public hearings are anything to go by.

Before the third and final phase gets under way next month - aka "season three" - here are some eye-catching moments from the last 64 days of hearings that saw 32 witnesses testifying.

In February, senior police officer Brig Rachel Matjeng appeared before the commission, which is named after retired Constitutional Court Justice Mbuyiseli Madlanga who is heading the inquiry.

She was there as she had overseen a tender awarded in 2024 to controversial businessman Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala's company Medicare24 Tshwane District, which was meant to provide health services to the police.

The contract was cancelled a year later and since then a dozen senior police officers, including Matjeng, have been formally charged over their role in awarding the contract. None of them have yet been asked to plead in court.

In her testimony to the commission, Matjeng denied receiving kickbacks from Matlala - and instead alleged that the pair were in an on-off romantic relationship that lasted until his arrest last year and that he had lavished her with gifts.

One of these presents were shots of the weight-loss drug Ozempic, which she had asked her "boyfriend" to source for her.

Matjeng said she had not been bribed with a Brazilian butt lift (BBL), as had been alleged online, telling the commission: "So, for me, from my boyfriend [Matlala], I only ask for Ozempic, unlike those that ask for BBL (sic)".

He was named in testimony last year from the police crime intelligence boss as one of the main figures in an alleged drug-trafficking and crime cartel, known as the Big Five, that allegedly also carried out contract killings, cross-border hijackings and kidnappings.

Matlala is currently in custody facing 25 criminal charges, among them attempted murder. He has denied all the charges against him.

It is believed that he will make a much-anticipated appearance - to respond to allegations made against him - during the final leg of the...
body.zh: 对南非涉嫌警察腐败的调查引起了举国关注，就像 Netflix 一部成功的犯罪剧第二季一样。 去年 7 月，一名高级警官提出指控，称有组织犯罪团伙已渗透到警察和政府中，此次真实调查的第一季从 9 月持续到 12 月。这些揭露的内容包括涉嫌贩毒集团的细节，并指出了涉嫌腐败的核心人物。 这项调查的“第二季”刚刚结束，另一份关于调查程序的临时报告已于周五移交给总统西里尔·拉马福萨。 与马德兰加委员会的第一份中期报告一样，该报告并未公开，但如果以公开听证会为依据的话，其内容可能相当具有爆炸性。 在下个月第三阶段（即最后阶段）（又称“第三季”）开始之前，以下是过去 64 天的听证会中的一些引人注目的时刻，有 32 名证人作证。 今年 2 月，高级警官雷切尔·马特吉恩 (Brig Rachel Matjeng) 出现在该委员会面前，该委员会以负责调查的退休宪法法院法官姆布伊塞利·马德兰加 (Mbuyiseli Madlanga) 的名字命名。 她在那里监督了 2024 年向备受争议的商人 Vusimuzi“Cat”Matlala 的公司 Medicare24 Tshwane District 进行的招标，该公司旨在为警方提供医疗服务。 一年后，该合同被取消，此后，包括马特吉在内的十几名高级警官因其在授予合同中所扮演的角色而受到正式指控。他们中没有人被要求出庭答辩。 在向委员会提供的证词中，马特詹否认接受了马特拉拉的回扣，而是声称两人一直处于断断续续的恋爱关系，这种关系一直持续到马特拉拉去年被捕，而且他还给她送了很多礼物。 其中一份礼物是减肥药 Ozempic，这是她让她的“男朋友”为她采购的。 Matjeng 表示，她并没有像网上所指控的那样，通过巴西提臀术 (BBL) 进行贿赂，她告诉委员会：“所以，对我来说，我的男朋友 [Matlala] 只要求 Ozempic，不像那些要求 BBL（原文如此）的人”。 去年，警方犯罪情报负责人在证词中指出，他是一个被称为“五巨头”的贩毒和犯罪卡特尔的主要人物之一，据称该卡特尔还进行了合同杀人、跨境劫持和绑架活动。 马特拉拉目前被拘留，面临 25 项刑事指控，其中包括谋杀未遂。他否认了对他的所有指控。 据信，他将在比赛的最后一站中进行万众期待的露面，以回应针对他的指控。

reflection.en: An ongoing police inquiry in South Africa highlights the corrosive power of greed when public trust is betrayed. The pursuit of illicit gain, whether through bribes or alleged drug heists, often stems from a misplaced love of money. This reminds us that true security and fulfillment are found not in accumulating wealth, but in integrity and service.
reflection.zh: 南非正在进行的警方调查揭示了当公众信任被背叛时，贪婪所具有的腐蚀性力量。无论是通过贿赂还是涉嫌毒品盗窃，对不义之财的追求往往源于对金钱的错误爱恋。这提醒我们，真正的安全和满足并非来自财富的积累，而在于正直和服侍。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Three Latvian mountaineers die on North America's tallest peak
title.zh: 三名拉脱维亚登山者在北美最高峰遇难

summary.en: Three climbers fell to their deaths near a perilous pass on Mount McKinley in the US's Denali National Park and Preserve. One mountaineer was rescued.
summary.zh: 三名登山者在美国迪纳利国家公园和保护区内的麦金利山一处险峻山口附近坠落身亡。另一名登山者获救。

body.en:
Three climbers fell to their deaths near a perilous pass on Mount McKinley in the US's Denali National Park and Preserve. One mountaineer was rescued.

Three climbers from Latvia who fell near a risky pass on Denali —  North America's highest peak — have died, a Latvian mountaineering group said Friday.

A fourth member from the mountaineering expedition was rescued in critical condition.

Denali, also known as Mount McKinley, stands at a height of 20,310 feet (6,190 meters) above sea level in the US state of Alaska.

A seven-person group was on the popular West Buttress route to the summit when four of the climbers fell during their ascent near Denali Pass on Wednesday, the Denali National Park and Preserve said.

The route is known for its crevasses, steep ice and exposed ridges, with many injuries and deaths occurring on it over the years.

The park service said the accident occurred at an altitude of over 5,500 meters.

The climber who was rescued was brought off a mountain basin, from about 5,240 meters, by the park's search and rescue personnel late Thursday afternoon.

A long line from a helicopter was used for the rescue as the terrain and conditions prevented the chopper from landing, the park service said.

The survivor was then transferred to an air ambulance for transport to a hospital.

The Latvian Mountaineering Association described the victims as "talented and experienced" mountaineers.

"This is an unspeakably painful, irreparable loss for the entire family of Latvian mountain climbers," the organization said in a statement posted on its website.

body.zh: 三名登山者在美国迪纳利国家公园和自然保护区麦金利山的一个危险山口附近坠落身亡。一名登山者获救。 拉脱维亚登山团体周五表示，三名来自拉脱维亚的登山者在北美最高峰麦金利峰的危险山口附近坠落身亡。 登山探险队的第四名成员获救，情况危急。 麦金利山，也称为麦金利山，位于美国阿拉斯加州，海拔 20,310 英尺（6,190 米）。 德纳利国家公园和自然保护区表示，周三，一个七人小组在热门的西巴特雷斯 (West Buttress) 登顶路线上，四名登山者在德纳利山口附近的攀登过程中摔倒。 这条路线以其裂缝、陡峭的冰层和裸露的山脊而闻名，多年来在这条路线上发生了许多伤亡事故。 公园管理局表示，事故发生在海拔超过5500米的地方。 周四下午晚些时候，公园搜救人员将获救的登山者从海拔约 5,240 米的山盆地救下。 公园管理局表示，由于地形和条件导致直升机无法着陆，因此使用了直升机上的长绳进行救援。 幸存者随后被转移到空中救护车送往医院。 拉脱维亚登山协会将受害者描述为“才华横溢且经验丰富”的登山者。 该组织在其网站上发布的一份声明中表示：“这对拉脱维亚登山者的整个家庭来说是难以形容的痛苦和无法挽回的损失。” 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，将我们选为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

Even in the face of such profound loss, the Psalmist's words offer a profound comfort, reminding us that we do not walk through the shadow of death alone. reflection.zh: 这则悲剧性的新闻提醒我们生命的脆弱，以及人类在挑战性活动中固有的风险。即使面对如此巨大的损失，诗篇作者的话语也提供了深刻的安慰，提醒我们即使走过死荫的幽谷，也并非孤单一人。对于那些悲伤的人来说，相信雅伟的同在能陪伴我们走过生命中最黑暗的幽谷，这是一种慰藉。

verse.textEn: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me.

title.en: Canadian who sold lethal chemical online pleads guilty to aiding suicides
title.zh: 在线销售致命化学品协助自杀的加拿大人认罪

summary.en: A Canadian man pleaded guilty to aiding suicides by selling lethal chemicals online. He sent over 1,200 packages of the substance and other related goods to individuals in 41 countries.

body.en:
A Canadian man who sold a legal but potentially deadly chemical online to dozens of people who took their own lives has pleaded guilty to aiding suicide.

The plea ended the prospect of a murder trial in a case with international reach.

Kenneth Law, 60, operated four companies with websites through which he marketed and sold sodium nitrite and other items, including masks, hoods and regulators, that were used by the purchasers to take their own lives.

Sodium nitrite, a salt used in low concentrations as a food additive to cure processed meats, can be deadly when ingested in high concentrations.

On Friday, Law pleaded guilty to aiding the suicides of 14 Ontario residents, aged 16 to 36 at the Ontario Superior Court of Justice in Newmarket, Ontario, north of Toronto. He will be sentenced in September.

Prosecutor Peter Westgate told Justice Michelle Fuerst that prosecutors would ask that 14 first-degree murder charges Law was also facing be withdrawn after his sentencing.

Family members of victims, some wiping their eyes with tissues, were visibly upset as prosecutor Cheryl Nadler read out the circumstances of each victim's death.

Law also admitted that 79 people in Britain died as a result of consuming or using products he sold.

Britain's Crown Prosecution Service said it had decided against seeking Law's extradition to stand trial in the UK, concluding that doing so carried a risk of refusal on double-jeopardy grounds.

Law sent 1,209 packages of the salt and other goods to customers in 41 countries between January 2021 and April 2023, the court heard. The shipments included 330 sent to addresses in Britain, 431 to the United States and 157 within Canada.

The case's statement of facts described victims who vomited, collapsed in their parents' arms, were found unresponsive in bed by family members or friends, or who died alone in hotel rooms and vehicles after consuming or using products shipped by Law.

"Many, many, many, many," Law told a reporter who was posing as a potential customer and asked how many people have been successful in killing themselves using his products, in a recorded phone call played in court.

Financial records showed more than C$296,000 ($298,500) in deposits to Law's bank account from Shopify and PayPal accounts associated with his businesses between 2020 and 2023.

"I genuinely thought that I was helping people to alleviate their suffering while making a small, modest profit," Law said in a personal letter found in his home.

The statement of facts said the parties in the case did not agree on what Law's statements meant about his motivation.

title.en: Canada could be facing a break-up — and these Aussies will have a say in it
title.zh: 加拿大可能面临分裂，这些澳大利亚人将有发言权

summary.en: Separatists in Alberta are advocating for a vote to leave the Canadian federation, drawing parallels to the United Kingdom's Brexit.
summary.zh: 阿尔伯塔省的分离主义者正在推动就是否脱离加拿大联邦进行投票，此举被比作英国脱欧。

body.en:
On his drilling rig, Mathew Anthes sees Alberta's fierce provincial pride up close: hard hats marked with Alberta flags, not Canadian ones.

"Everyone's proud to be Albertan, but they wouldn't necessarily say that they're proud to be Canadian," Anthes said.

Born and raised in Canberra, Anthes lived for much of his life in Melbourne beofre moving to the little town of Rocky Mountain House in the province of Alberta, Canada, in 2018.

Like many people in the region, he works in the oil and gas industry. The province contains virtually all of Canada's oil reserves, something that those who wish to separate from the rest of the country believe will ensure Alberta's prosperity as an independent territory.

Indeed, the concept of 'Albexit' has its roots in the 1973 oil crisis, when locals clashed with the federal government over the wealth the fossil fuel provides the rest of the country.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In 2026, with another oil crisis sweeping the globe , Albertans will finally be going to the polls in October to vote on a motion that could begin the process of separation from the rest of the country.

The question being put to voters is: "Should Alberta remain a province of Canada or should the Government of Alberta commence the legal process required under the Canadian Constitution to hold a binding provincial referendum on whether or not Alberta should separate from Canada?".

The vote, like all ballot measures in Canada, is not mandatory, as it is in Australia. However, polling by the not-for-profit Angus Reid Institute suggests that up to two-thirds of the 5 million Albertans would vote against having a vote to leave Canada.

The referendum is being likened to the ballot measure that saw the United Kingdom remove itself from the European Union.

That is not least of all because the premier of Alberta, Danielle Smith, is the moderate leader of a right-wing United Conservative Party (UCP), who many believe has only called the vote to appease more hardline members of her party — much like the British Conservative prime minister, David Cameron.

Smith, in a televised address on Thursday, said that she had to respect the will of the 700,000 Albertans who signed two petitions calling for a vote on the issue.

"Kicking the can down the road only prolongs a very emotional and important debate, and muzzling the voices of hundreds of thousands of Albertans wanting to be heard is unjustifiable in a free and democratic society," she said.

"It’s time to have a vote, understand the will of Albertans on this subject, and move on."

title.en: Romania's political crisis deepens
title.zh: 罗马尼亚政治危机加剧

summary.en: After Prime Minister Ilie Bolojan’s government fell in early May, Romania's moderate parties have struggled to chart a new course, creating an opportunity for the far right to gain influence.
summary.zh: 罗马尼亚总理伊利耶·博洛扬政府于五月初垮台后，该国温和派政党难以制定新路线，这为极右翼势力提供了壮大的机会。

body.en:
After Prime Minister Ilie Bolojan’s government fell in early May, Romania's moderate parties have struggled to chart a new course — opening the door for the far right to gain ground.

The four-party coalition that ruled Romania from the summer 2025 up until just a few weeks ago was viewed by many as the country's last chance of preventing the far right from coming to power. It was hoped that solid governance an reforms would keep the extremists in check.

Yet this strategy appears to have failed. Romania's right-wing extremists are riding high in opinion polls, while its moderate parties are bogged down by political squabbling. It's been three weeks since liberal Prime Minister Ilie Bolojan's government collapsed after his own camp launched a vote of no confidence, and none of the country's moderate parties have so far been able to agree who should succeeded him — even though President Nicusor Dan has done his utmost to mediate talks.

But that's not all. While the Bolojan government formally remains in power until it is replaced, Romania's Social Democrats (PSD), who hold most seats in parliament and supposedly support the EU, are increasingly collaborating with the far-right Alliance for the Unification of Romania (AUR). Indeed, political scientist Raluca Alexandrescu says Romania is seeing a "normalization of right-wing extremism."

A massive upheaval could ensue if the pro-Russian, anti-Ukrainian and anti-EU AUR comes to power, or even just plays a supporting role in a Romanian minority government.

After all, Romania is the sixth largest EU country and most important NATO member state in southeastern Europe. It hosts some of the largest and most important NATO bases in the region. Romania has the longest EU border with Ukraine out of all member states and has consistently backed the embattled nation fighting back Russian invaders.

May's no confidence vote, initiated by PSD together with the AUR, was evidence that a dangerous normalization of the far right is ongoing. The PSD, for that matter, was part of Bolojan's coalition.

While there have been previous instances of moderate parties collaborated with right-wing extremists in Romanian parliament, this was the very first time they joined forces to bring down a government. This was the moment the far-right firewall crumbled.

While the PSD has often said it does not aim to form an alliance with the AUR, its actions speak another language. In mid-May, the PSD joined Romania's three far-right parties in supporting a legislative project in parliament's human rights committee to overturn a ban on anti-Semitic, fascist and racist propaganda. body.zh: 新任总理彼得·马扎尔领导下的改革将使欧盟能够为布达佩斯释放数十亿美元的冻结援助。欧盟委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩在马扎尔访问布鲁塞尔时宣布了这一消息。 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩周五在布鲁塞尔表示，匈牙利新政府领导下的改革进展将使欧盟委员会能够解冻之前冻结的价值164亿欧元（约合191亿美元）的欧盟复苏和凝聚基金。 她在与匈牙利新任总理彼得·马扎尔（Peter Magyar）会谈后对记者发表讲话，后者在上个月的选举中击败了前任维克托·欧尔班（Viktor Orban）。 在欧尔班的领导下，布达佩斯和布鲁塞尔经常发生冲突——无论是在匈牙利国内问题还是在俄罗斯入侵期间支持乌克兰等外交政策问题上。结果，旨在帮助欧盟较贫穷成员国之一的各种资金被冻结多年。 冯德莱恩在布鲁塞尔的新闻发布会上详细介绍了援助的来源。 她表示：“我可以确认，下一代欧盟（欧盟复苏基金）中已经解冻或将要解冻的有 100 亿欧元，然后是凝聚基金中的 42 亿欧元，随着改革的完成，还有 22 亿欧元。” “这是一笔相当大的数目，但是......匈牙利人民应得的。再次，非常非常感谢所做的出色工作，”这位德国政治家站在马扎尔旁边说道。 新总理称周五达成的协议是“历史性突破”，并表示他已就允许释放的所有步骤达成一致，并且匈牙利将能够通过必要的法律。 马扎尔告诉记者：“正如我们所承诺的那样，我们将把这笔钱带回家，用于重建匈牙利，启动经济，恢复和发展公共服务，并加强匈牙利公司和中小企业的竞争力。” 过去三年，匈牙利经济或多或少停滞不前，仅实现最低限度的增长。 尽管前总理欧尔班在选举前进行了大量支出，但今年的预算赤字可能达到GDP的6.2%——远远超过欧盟目标——不断膨胀。央行基准利率为6.25%，远高于欧洲央行的2%。 自马扎尔当选以来，本国货币福林已经反弹，部分原因是欧盟恢复资金的预期。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，将我们选为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

title.en: Ethiopia election 2026: Tigray excluded and on edge
title.zh: 埃塞俄比亚2026年大选：提格雷地区被排除在外，局势紧张

summary.en: As Ethiopia prepares for its upcoming elections, the Tigray region will not participate for the second consecutive time, leading to continued tensions. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed and his Prosperity Party are widely expected to secure a victory.
summary.zh: 随着埃塞俄比亚准备举行大选，提格雷地区将第二次不参与投票，导致紧张局势持续。与此同时，预计总理阿比·艾哈迈德及其繁荣党将赢得选举。

body.en:
As Ethiopia is heading to the polls, the Tigray region won't be participating in the vote for the second time, with tensions simmering on. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed and his Prosperity Party meanwhile are expected to win.

There is not a single delegate in Ethiopia's outgoing lower house of parliament, known as the House of Peoples' Representatives, nor in the upper house — the House of Federation — currently representing the embattled Tigray region.

Missing out on another election in 2026 will bring Tigray's total absence from the political arena in Addis Ababa to a full decade. Many wonder where this leaves the region, as tensions appear to flare up again.

"Can we still say with certainty that 'Tigray is part of Ethiopia ?' I am not sure," says Alemayehu Fentaw, a fellow at the Center for Constitutional Democracy at the Indiana University Maurer School of Law.

Others seem to share a similarly despondent view of the situation — or worse.

Ethiopia's federal government is legally mandated to ensure and facilitate the representation of Tigray in its federal institutions, including the two chambers, as per the agreement signed following AU-led mediation in Pretoria in 2022.

However, that agreement has repeatedly failed to live up to expectations, other than  largely succeeding in silencing active fighting in the region ; above all, it has not helped bring democracy back to Tigray. 

"More than 40% of the sovereign territory of Tigray is under enemy control," says  Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF)  spokesman Michaele Asgedom, highlighting that the region is unable "to conduct an election" after years of conflict.

Asgedom explains that millions of internally displaced people who had fled from Tigray  due to the bloody civil war   have not returned home, in addition to countless people who had originally sought refuge in neighboring   Sudan ; any election held in Tigray would therefore not be representative of all Tigrayans, he tells DW.

But there's more than a disparate electorate that has observers worrying about the fragile peace in the region, as the rest of the country prepares to go to the polls: The 2020 to 2022 Tigray war still casts its long shadow.

In 2020, Ethiopia's government under Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed had to postpone the country's planned elections due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

The TPLF — the largest and most dominant party in the country's northern Tigray region — accused Abiy of  unconstitutionally extending his government's term this way, and went on to arrange its own local elections, which it won.

body.zh: 随着埃塞俄比亚即将举行投票，提格雷地区将不会第二次参加投票，紧张局势仍在持续。与此同时，总理阿比·艾哈迈德和他的繁荣党预计将获胜。 埃塞俄比亚即将卸任的议会下议院（即人民代表院）和上议院（联邦议院）目前都没有一名代表代表陷入困境的提格雷地区。 如果错过 2026 年的另一次选举，蒂格雷将彻底缺席亚的斯亚贝巴的政治舞台整整十年。随着紧张局势似乎再次加剧，许多人想知道这会给该地区带来什么影响。 “我们还能肯定地说‘提格雷是埃塞俄比亚的一部分吗？’ 我不确定，”印第安纳大学毛雷尔法学院宪政民主中心研究员阿莱马耶胡·芬托 (Alemayehu Fentaw) 说。 其他人似乎对这种情况也有同样的沮丧看法——或者更糟。 根据 2022 年非盟主导的比勒陀利亚调解后签署的协议，埃塞俄比亚联邦政府有法律授权确保和促进提格雷在其联邦机构（包括两院）中的代表权。 然而，该协议除了很大程度上成功地平息了该地区的激烈战斗之外，一再未能达到预期。最重要的是，它并没有帮助提格雷恢复民主。 提格雷人民解放阵线 (TPLF) 发言人米歇尔·阿斯吉多姆 (Michaele Asgedom) 表示：“提格雷超过 40% 的主权领土处于敌人控制之下。”他强调，该地区在多年冲突后无法“举行选举”。 阿斯吉多姆解释说，除了无数原本在邻国苏丹寻求庇护的人外，数百万因血腥内战而逃离提格雷的国内流离失所者还没有返回家园；他告诉德国之声，因此在提格雷举行的任何选举都不能代表所有提格雷人。 但当该国其他地区准备投票时，观察者们担心该地区脆弱的和平的不仅仅是不同的选民：2020 年至 2022 年的提格雷战争仍然投下长长的阴影。 2020 年，由于 COVID-19 大流行，阿比·艾哈迈德总理领导的埃塞俄比亚政府不得不推迟该国计划的选举。 提格雷人民解放阵线是该国北部提格雷地区最大、最具统治力的政党，指责阿比以这种方式延长其政府任期违宪，并继续安排自己的地方选举，并赢得了选举。 随后，...

title.en: Shangri-La Dialogue: Hegseth says 'no state, including China,' must dominate Asia
title.zh: 香格里拉对话：赫格塞思称“包括中国在内，任何国家”都不得主导亚洲

summary.en: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth voiced concerns over China's military expansion in Asia during the Shangri-La Dialogue. He also urged Asian allies and partners to raise their defense spending to 3.5% of their GDP.
summary.zh: 美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞思在香格里拉对话期间对中国在亚洲的军事集结表示担忧。他还表示，美国期望其在亚洲的盟友和伙伴将国防开支增加到其GDP的3.5%。

body.en:
US Defense Secretary of Pete Hegseth expressed alarm about China's military buildup in Asia. He also said the United States expects its allies and partners in Asia to increase defense spending to 3.5% of their GDP.

In his speech Saturday at the Shangri-La Dialogue in  Singapore , Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth outlined US foreign policy goals for Asia.

Hegseth told the defense summit that the United States seeks a "stable equilibrium" in Asia. He added that no country — including China — should be able to establish unquestioned dominance over the region.

"What we seek ... is a genuinely stable equilibrium that works for Americans as well as our allies — a favorable but durable balance of power in which no state, including China, can impose its hegemony and hold the security or prosperity of our nation and our allies in question," the Pentagon chief said.

Hegseth said there was "rightful alarm" about China's military buildup across the Pacific region, but stressed that Washington does not seek "needless confrontation in the region."

"When we look across the region today, there is rightful alarm regarding China's historic military buildup and the expansion of its military activities in the region and beyond," Hegseth said.

Hegseth stressed that ties with Beijing are "better than they have been in many years," citing the increased number of military-to-military interactions as an example.

Richard Walker, DW's chief international editor, noted that Taiwan was not mentioned once in Hegseth's speech. When asked about the  paused arms sale deal with Taiwan , the Pentagon chief answered that the decision would rest with President Donald Trump .

The defense secretary also said the US expects its Asian allies and partners to increase defense spending to 3.5% of their GDPs.

"The era of ⁠the United States ​subsidizing the defense of wealthy nations is over... We need partners, not protectorates," he said. "We don't have a strong alliance unless everyone has skin in the game. No freeloading."

Since returning to the office, Trump has demanded that US allies, particularly NATO countries, increase their defense spending and reduce their reliance on Washington.

Hegseth also stressed that the United States has more than sufficient stockpiles of weapons and is "more than capable" of resuming the war with Iran.

Georg Mattes, the DW Asia Pacific bureau chief, said the key phrase in Hegseth's speech was that there is less need for the Shangri-La Dialogue and more need for a military buildup and deterrence. Mattes added, "I think that is a bit unsettling scenario for Southeastern Asians."

title.en: Ex-head monk of China's 'kung fu temple' jailed for embezzlement
title.zh: 中国“功夫寺庙”前住持因贪污罪被判入狱

summary.en: Shi Yongxin, the former head monk of China's renowned 'kung fu temple,' has been sentenced to 24 years in prison. The conviction follows charges of embezzlement and bribery.
summary.zh: 中国著名“功夫寺庙”的前方丈释永信因贪污受贿被判处24年有期徒刑。

body.en:
The former head of China's famous Shaolin Temple - known as the birthplace of kung fu - has been sentenced to 24 years in jail for crimes including embezzlement and bribery.

Shi Yongxin had misappropriated temple assets worth more than 282m yuan ($42m; £31m) from 2003 to 2025, a court in the central Henan province said.

It said Shi had also used his official position to illegally obtain millions from temple construction projects, as well as offering huge bribes to Chinese officials.

Shi - whose birth name is Liu Yingcheng - had earlier admitted his guilt, China's state Xinhua news agency reported. On Friday, he said he would not appeal against the verdict.

The 1,500-year-old Shaolin Temple - located on a mountain range - attracts thousands of disciples from China and elsewhere every year.

Shi took office there as abbot in 1999, soon earning the nickname "CEO monk" for transforming the institution into a global brand.

Under his leadership, the temple started opening schools outside China and formed a travelling troupe of monks who performed Shaolin kung fu shows - the temple's signature style of martial arts.

Shi was investigated for embezzlement and fathering several children in 2015, but was later cleared of the charges.

In an interview with BBC Chinese that year, he said: "If there were a problem, it would have surfaced long ago."

The name "Shaolin Temple" has gained prominence in pop culture over the years, including being the title of a 1982 film starring Jet Li.

The temple is referenced in songs by American hip-hop group Wu-Tang Clan and inspired a spin-off of the video game Mortal Kombat.
body.zh: 中国著名功夫发源地少林寺的前掌门因贪污和受贿等罪被判处 24 年有期徒刑。 河南省中部一家法院表示，从 2003 年到 2025 年，释永信挪用了价值超过 2.82 亿元人民币（4200 万美元；3100 万英镑）的寺庙资产。 据称，施还利用其职务之便，从寺庙建设项目中非法获取数百万美元，并向中国官员行贿。 据中国官方新华社报道，石本名刘英成早些时候已承认有罪。周五，他表示不会对判决提出上诉。 拥有 1,500 年历史的少林寺坐落在山脉上，每年吸引着来自中国和其他地方的数千名弟子。 1999年，释永信出任方丈，很快就因将该机构转变为全球品牌而赢得了“CEO和尚”的绰号。 在他的领导下，少林寺开始在中国境外开设学校，并组建了一个由僧人组成的巡回演出团，表演少林功夫表演——少林寺的标志性武术风格。 2015年，石因贪污和生下几个孩子而受到调查，但后来被洗清了罪名。 当年接受BBC中文采访时，他说：“如果有问题，早就浮现出来了。” 多年来，“少林寺”这个名字在流行文化中占据了重要地位，其中包括成为 1982 年李连杰主演的电影的片名。 美国嘻哈乐队 Wu-Tang Clan 的歌曲中提到了这座寺庙，并为电子游戏《真人快打》的衍生作品提供了灵感。

reflection.en: The conviction of a religious leader for embezzlement and bribery highlights the universal call to integrity, especially for those entrusted with public trust. Jesus taught that faithfulness in small matters reflects one's character in larger responsibilities. This serves as a sober reminder that true spiritual authority is rooted in honest stewardship, not...
reflection.zh: 一位宗教领袖因贪污受贿被定罪，这突显了对诚信的普遍呼唤，特别是对那些被赋予公众信任的人。耶稣教导说，在小事上忠心的人，在大事上也忠心。这提醒我们，真正的属灵权柄根植于诚实的管家职分，而非世俗的利益。

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
verse.textZh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。

title.en: Germany deepens Taiwan ties amid China tensions
title.zh: 德国在中国紧张局势中深化与台湾的关系

summary.en: A German parliamentary delegation, the Berlin-Taipei Parliamentary Friendship Group, recently visited Taiwan, a move that drew criticism from Beijing. Two lawmakers stated the visit was crucial for expanding economic partnerships.
summary.zh: 一个名为柏林-台北议会友好小组的德国代表团最近访问了台湾，此举引来了北京的批评。两名议员表示，此次访问对于扩大经济伙伴关系至关重要。

body.en:
A German delegation, known as the Berlin-Taipei Parliamentary Friendship Group, recently visited Taiwan, drawing criticism from Beijing. Two lawmakers told DW the visit was important for expanding economic partnerships.

While German Economic Affairs Minister Katherina Reiche is visiting Beijing , a delegation from the Bundestag, Germany's lower house of parliament is in  Taiwan . 

The Berlin-Taipei Parliamentary Friendship Group, a cross-party association of MPs that promotes international exchange, has traveled there to "strengthen economic and cultural cooperation with one of the region's most important democratic partners," the Bundestag said in a statement.

Till Steffen of the Green Party is leading the five-member delegation, which also includes lawmakers Klaus-Peter Willsch and Markus Reichel from Chancellor Friedrich Merz's conservative Christian Democrats (CDU) , as well as Rainer Kraft from the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) and Mandy Eissing from the Left Party .

The nine-day trip has sparked criticism from Beijing. Chinese Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning said China has always opposed any form of official exchanges between its diplomatic partners and Taiwan.

Beijing sees self-ruled Taiwan as a breakaway province that one day will be "reunited" with the mainland.

"It is in Germany's interest to have a balanced situation and not to depend solely on China," said delegation leader Steffen. Economic dependence on China — for example in batteries for electric cars — has put Germany in a difficult position, he added.

"It is fine to do business with Beijing, but we should not become dependent on China," Steffen said. "That is why it is necessary to maintain close relations with other countries at the same time. It is therefore a good thing that we are carrying out a joint research project with Taiwan on the batteries of the future." 

The AfD's Kraft points out that before German reunification in 1990, China maintained diplomatic relations with both the Federal Republic of Germany (FRG) and the German Democratic Republic (GDR) at the same time.

Although Germany does not maintain official diplomatic relations with Taiwan, it has economic, cultural and research ties with the island.

"It is very important for Germany to be a partner to Taiwan," he told DW. "Taiwan is a global leader in the semiconductor sector. Semiconductors are essential for the economy of the future — for artificial intelligence and data centers. Given our economic challenges, Germany must not miss the opportunity to remain economically strong in the future."

Taiwanese semiconductor giant TSMC has been building a new factory in the eastern German state of Saxony since 2024.

Together with the German companies Bosch, Infineon...
body.zh: 一个名为“柏林-台北议会友好小组”的德国代表团最近访问了台湾，引发了北京的批评。两名议员告诉德国之声，这次访问对于扩大经济伙伴关系非常重要。 德国经济事务部长凯瑟琳娜·赖希 (Katherina Reiche) 访问北京期间，德国议会下议院联邦议院的代表团正在台湾。 德国联邦议院在一份声明中表示，柏林-台北议会友好小组是一个促进国际交流的跨党派议员协会，已前往那里“加强与该地区最重要的民主伙伴之一的经济和文化合作”。 绿党的蒂尔·史蒂芬（Till Steffen）率领这个五人代表团，其中还包括德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨（Friedrich Merz）领导的保守派基督教民主党（CDU）的议员克劳斯-彼得·威尔施（Klaus-Peter Willsch）和马库斯·赖切尔（Markus Reichel），以及极右翼的德国另类选择党（AfD）的莱纳·克拉夫特（Rainer Kraft）和左翼党的曼迪·艾辛（Mandy Eissing）。 这次为期9天的访问引发了北京方面的批评。中国外交部发言人毛宁表示，中方一贯反对外交伙伴与台湾开展任何形式的官方往来。 北京将自治的台湾视为一个分裂的省份，有一天将与大陆“统一”。 代表团团长斯特芬表示：“保持平衡的局势而不是仅仅依赖中国符合德国的利益。”他补充说，经济对中国的依赖——例如电动汽车电池——使德国陷入了困境。 “与北京做生意很好，但我们不应该依赖中国，”史蒂芬说。 “这就是为什么有必要同时与其他国家保持密切关系。因此，我们与台湾开展关于未来电池的联合研究项目是一件好事。” 德国选择党的克拉夫特指出，1990年德国统一之前，中国同时与德意志联邦共和国和德意志民主共和国保持着外交关系。 尽管德国与台湾没有保持正式外交关系，但与台湾有经济、文化和研究联系。 他告诉德国之声：“德国成为台湾的合作伙伴非常重要。” “台湾是半导体行业的全球领导者。半导体对于未来的经济——人工智能和数据中心至关重要。鉴于我们的经济挑战，德国绝不能错过未来保持经济强劲的机会。” 自 2024 年以来，台湾半导体巨头台积电一直在德国东部萨克森州建设新工厂。 与德国公司博世、英飞凌一起...

reflection.en: In a world of complex international relations, nations often navigate delicate balances to foster partnerships while managing existing tensions. Romans 12:18 encourages us to live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on us, reminding us that even in diplomatic endeavors, the pursuit of harmonious coexistence remains a vital aspiration. This...
reflection.zh: 在复杂的国际关系中，各国常需在促进伙伴关系与处理现有紧张局势之间寻求微妙的平衡。罗马书12:18鼓励我们，若是可能，总要尽力与众人和睦，提醒我们即使在外交努力中，追求和谐共存仍是一个重要的愿望。这一原则呼吁深思熟虑的接触，即使在不同观点中也要寻求共同点和理解。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Asian mothers, bad feelings: notes on an all-conquering stereotype – podcast
title.zh: 亚洲母亲，负面感受：关于一种无处不在的刻板印象的思考——播客

summary.en: A recent podcast explores the pervasive "tiger mom" stereotype in popular culture, which often portrays Asian mothers as strict, cold, and demanding. The discussion delves into why this particular image has become so widespread.
summary.zh: 一档播客节目探讨了流行文化中无处不在的“虎妈”刻板印象，这种形象常将亚洲母亲描绘成严厉、冷漠且要求苛刻。节目深入分析了这种特定形象为何如此普遍。

reflection.en: Stereotypes, like the "tiger mom" image, often reduce individuals to a narrow caricature, obscuring the rich diversity and unique dignity of each person. Remembering that every human being is created in God's image helps us challenge such generalizations and see others with respect and understanding. This perspective encourages us to look beyond simplistic...
reflection.zh: 刻板印象，例如“虎妈”形象，常常将个体简化为狭隘的漫画式形象，掩盖了每个人丰富的多样性和独特的尊严。铭记每个人都是按着神的形象被造的，这有助于我们挑战此类概括性看法，并以尊重和理解的态度看待他人。这种视角鼓励我们超越简单的标签，欣赏邻舍完整的人性。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: How did this novel about food win a Booker Prize this year?
title.zh: 这本关于美食的小说今年是如何赢得布克奖的？

summary.en: Taiwan Travelogue, a novel translated from Mandarin Chinese, has made history by becoming the first of its kind to win the prestigious Booker Prize. The book focuses on themes related to food and culture.
summary.zh: 小说《台湾游记》成为首部获得久负盛名的布克奖的华语译作，创造了历史。该书以美食和文化为主题。

body.en:
Taiwan Travelogue, a tale of forbidden love and Taiwanese food, has won the International Booker Prize.

It's the first novel translated from Mandarin Chinese to win the prestigious award. BBC Chinese met with author Yang Shuang-zi for a food tour, and to learn more about her inspiration behind the book.

Rescuers in Laos have found five villagers alive inside a flooded cave after they were trapped for a week.

The BBC's Sumedha Pal described how difficult it was to be standing in the streets of Delhi as temperatures rose to 45C .

The temple has moved the flame to a different location and authorities said the fire may have been caused by it, according to Japan Times.

A North Korean women's football team played in South Korea marking the first time athletes from the North have crossed the border in nearly 8 years.

Rounds of gunfire were heard but officials have not revealed who fired the shots.

Pakistan says it hit 'military and terrorist infrastructure' - but the UN and victims' families reject this claim.

Officials said the group had been hiking up the active volcano despite a climbing ban.

Japan's PM is pushing to revise country's pacifist constitution - and it's causing controversy.

Analysts say the daughter of North Korea’s leader Kim Jong Un is not just growing up - she’s being styled for succession.

A glamping facility was destroyed by the raging torrent in Bogor, West Java on 4 May.

At least 15 people have died after a train crashed into the female-only carriage of a commuter train in Bekasi.

Thousands of people have been displaced after a fire destroyed around 1,000 homes in Malaysia's Sabah state.

The escape of Neukgu, a two-year-old wolf, from a zoo in the city of Daejon captured national attention.

The Philippine President challenged anyone questioning his fitness to join him in the gym.

Asha Bhosle died in Mumbai on Sunday after being admitted to the hospital following a heart attack.

K-pop stars BTS kicked off their marathon world tour in South Korea, with a heavy nod to their new album Arirang.

The megastars kick off their grandest tour, the largest in K-pop history, in Seoul on Thursday after a nearly four-year hiatus.

Min Aung Hlaing presided over his last military parade in Myanmar before he takes up the role of president.

Drivers are queuing for hours at petrol stations in Myanmar as the Iran war continues to send shockwaves across the globe.

BBC News Asia Business Correspondent Suranajana Tewari spoke to people taking to the streets of Manila.
body.zh: 《台湾游记》讲述了禁忌之爱和台湾美食的故事，荣获国际布克奖。 这是第一部获得这一殊荣的中文翻译小说。 BBC中文网采访了作家杨双子，进行美食之旅，并进一步了解她这本书背后的灵感。 老挝的救援人员在一个被洪水淹没的山洞里发现了五名被困一周的村民，他们还活着。 BBC 的 Sumedha Pal 描述了当气温升至 45 摄氏度时站在德里的街道上是多么困难。 据《日本时报》报道，寺庙已将火苗移至其他地点，当局表示火灾可能是由此引起的。 朝鲜女子足球队在韩国比赛，这是近八年来朝鲜运动员首次跨越边境。 听到几声枪响，但官员们没有透露是谁开枪的。 巴基斯坦称其袭击了“军事和恐怖主义基础设施”，但联合国和受害者家属否认了这一说法。 官员们表示，尽管有攀登禁令，该组织仍在攀登活火山。 日本首相正在推动修改该国的和平宪法，这引起了争议。 分析人士表示，朝鲜领导人金正恩的女儿不仅在成长，而且正在为接班人做好准备。 5 月 4 日，西爪哇省茂物市的一处豪华露营设施被汹涌的洪流摧毁。 一辆火车撞上勿加泗通勤列车的女性专用车厢，造成至少 15 人死亡。 马来西亚沙巴州发生火灾，烧毁了约 1,000 所房屋，导致数千人流离失所。 两岁大的狼 Neukgu 从大田市动物园逃跑引起了全国关注。 菲律宾总统要求任何质疑他健康状况的人都和他一起去健身房。 阿莎·博斯勒 (Asha Bhosle) 因心脏病突发入院，于周日在孟买去世。 韩国流行歌星防弹少年团 (BTS) 在韩国拉开了马拉松世界巡演的序幕，向他们的新专辑《阿里郎》致敬。 经过近四年的中断后，这些巨星将于周四在首尔开始他们最盛大的巡演，这也是韩国流行音乐历史上规模最大的巡演。 敏昂莱主持了就任总统之前在缅甸的最后一次阅兵。 随着伊朗战争继续在全球范围内产生冲击波，司机们在缅甸的加油站排队几个小时。 BBC 新闻亚洲商业记者 Suranajana Tewari 向走上马尼拉街头的人们发表讲话。

reflection.en: This literary achievement reminds us of the profound capacity for human creativity, a reflection of our being God's handiwork. Through stories, even those centered on food, we connect across cultures and celebrate the good works we are created to do, enriching the world with beauty and understanding.
reflection.zh: 这一文学成就提醒我们人类拥有深刻的创造力，这正是我们作为雅伟杰作的体现。通过故事，即使是那些以美食为中心的故事，我们也能跨越文化界限，庆祝我们被造所要行的善工，以美和理解丰富世界。

verse.textEn: For we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.
verse.textZh: 我们原是他的工作，在基督耶稣里造成的，为要叫我们行善，就是神所预备叫我们行的。

title.en: EU to discuss potential restrictions on Chinese imports amid fears of overreliance
title.zh: 欧盟讨论限制中国进口，担忧过度依赖

summary.en: EU commissioners are set to meet to discuss potential restrictions on Chinese imports. Concerns are growing that a surge in imports could lead to economic decline in the bloc, similar to the challenges faced by US rust belt towns.
summary.zh: 欧盟委员会成员将开会讨论对中国进口商品实施潜在限制。人们越来越担心，进口激增可能导致欧盟经济衰退，类似于美国“铁锈地带”城镇所面临的挑战。

body.en: Concerns among commissioners in bloc that surge in imports could lead to decline similar to that of US rust belt towns EU commissioners will meet on Friday for crunch talks aimed at imposing new restrictions on imports from China amid growing concern that Beijing is fuelling conditions for US-style rust belt towns in Europe. The surge in imports of everything from electric cars to key components in machines, medical devices and foodstuffs has been dubbed China Shock 2.0, potentially mirroring the experience in the US 25 years ago when Beijing joined the World Trade Organization. Continue reading...
body.zh: 欧盟委员担心进口激增可能导致类似于美国铁锈地带城镇的衰退。欧盟委员将于周五举行紧急会谈，旨在对中国进口实施新的限制，因为人们越来越担心北京正在加剧欧洲铁锈地带城镇的美国式状况。从电动汽车到机器关键零部件、医疗设备和食品等各种商品的进口激增被称为“中国冲击2.0”，这可能与25年前北京加入世界贸易组织时美国的经历如出一辙。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As EU leaders consider economic policies, the wisdom of foresight becomes crucial. Prudence involves recognizing potential dangers, such as overreliance on imports, and taking timely steps to safeguard long-term stability. This proactive approach aims to protect communities from future hardship.
reflection.zh: 欧盟领导人在考虑经济政策时，远见的智慧至关重要。审慎意味着识别潜在危险，例如过度依赖进口，并及时采取措施维护长期稳定。这种积极主动的方法旨在保护社区免受未来的困境。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: EU fines Temu for failing to stop sale of illegal and dangerous products
title.zh: Temu因未能停止销售非法和危险产品而被欧盟罚款

summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: New Chinese surveillance leaves foreigners nowhere to hide
title.zh: 中国新监控系统让外国人无处藏身

summary.en: A Chinese cybersecurity expert has disclosed details of China's advanced high-tech policing system to DW. This system uses facial recognition at ski resorts and tracks individuals on trains, compiling comprehensive "holistic profiles" that leave foreigners with no place to hide.
summary.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声透露了中国新型高科技警务的细节。该系统利用滑雪场的面部识别和火车上的追踪，可以追踪任何人并建立“综合档案”，让外国人无处藏身。

body.en:
A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed to DW details of China's new high-tech policing. From ski resort facial recognition to seats on a train, the system can track anyone and compile a "holistic profile."

When a cybersecurity researcher known by the pseudonym NetAskari recently clicked on a tab labeled "Inquiry for journalist files" on an unsecured Chinese web dashboard, he expected to see a jumble of auto-generated mock data.

Instead, familiar faces popped up on the screen. It was a comprehensive database of almost every foreign journalist based in Beijing around 2021, including official passport photos taken at the entry/exit bureau, private cellphone numbers, visa details and dates of birth. He also found his own exact personal information lying dormant on this Chinese police watch list.

"It was more interesting than shocking," NetAskari told DW. "When you work as a journalist in China , you basically assume you are always on their radar. But what surprised me was simply how easy it was to access this highly sensitive system."

What NetAskari had stumbled upon is part modern China's emerging system of "holographic profiles."

He had unwittingly accessed a demonstration version of a remote tracking system designed for the Public Security Bureau in Zhangjiakou, the Hebei province city that hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics.

Though it was only a test panel, it was populated with real datasets, clearly outlining the trajectory of China's state surveillance machine, which is rapidly evolving from a network of simple street cameras into a data-fused, 24/7, predictive social control behemoth.

For years, China has operated the world's most extensive CCTV network. A massive initiative known as the "Xueliang" (Bright Eyes) project aims to merge these isolated islands of surveillance spread across the country.

But the data on the Zhangjiakou police dashboard shows the granular detail with which authorities can track an individual.

This system no longer relies solely on police cameras on street corners; it accurately records the specific train carriage and seat number a target occupies when arriving from Beijing or Shanghai, for example.

It even synchronizes photos taken by facial-recognition ticket gates at local ski resorts directly into its tracking mechanism. The movements of the researcher's acquaintances who recently skied in Zhangjiakou were precisely flagged and mapped out with detailed trajectories in the system.

"The idea is simply to process as much data as possible from as many sensors as possible in real time," the researcher noted.

The system logs daily behaviors like gasoline consumption, regular shopping locations and whether an individual frequently visits "petition areas."

This massive data-fusion effort...
body.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声透露了中国新型高科技警务的细节。从滑雪场面部识别到火车座位，该系统可以跟踪任何人并编制“整体档案”。 当一位化名 NetAskari 的网络安全研究人员最近点击一个不安全的中文网络仪表板上标有“查询记者档案”的选项卡时，他预计会看到一堆自动生成的模拟数据。 取而代之的是，熟悉的面孔出现在屏幕上。这是一个综合数据库，包含 2021 年左右驻京的几乎所有外国记者，包括在出入境局拍摄的官方护照照片、私人手机号码、签证详细信息和出生日期。他还发现自己的确切个人信息隐藏在这份中国警方的监视名单上。 “这比令人震惊更有趣，”内特阿斯卡里告诉德国之声。 “当你在中国担任记者时，你基本上会认为你总是在他们的监视范围内。但令我惊讶的是访问这个高度敏感的系统是多么容易。” NetAskari 偶然发现的是现代中国新兴的“全息轮廓”系统的一部分。 他无意中访问了为主办 2022 年冬季奥运会的河北省张家口市公安局设计的远程跟踪系统演示版本。 虽然它只是一个测试面板，但它填充了真实的数据集，清楚地概述了中国国家监控机器的轨迹，该机器正在从简单的街道摄像头网络迅速演变为数据融合的、24/7、预测性的社会控制庞然大物。 多年来，中国运营着世界上最广泛的闭路电视网络。一项名为“雪亮”（明亮的眼睛）项目的大规模倡议旨在合并这些分布在全国各地的监视孤岛。 但张家口警方仪表板上的数据显示了当局可以追踪个人的详细信息。 该系统不再仅仅依赖于街角的警察摄像头；例如，它可以准确记录目标从北京或上海抵达时所乘坐的具体火车车厢和座位号。 它甚至将当地滑雪场的面部识别检票口拍摄的照片直接同步到其跟踪机制中。研究人员最近在张家口滑雪的熟人的动作被精确标记，并在系统中绘制出详细的轨迹。 研究人员指出：“这个想法只是实时处理来自尽可能多的传感器的尽可能多的数据。” 该系统会记录日常行为，例如汽油消耗、常规购物地点以及个人是否经常访问“请愿区”。 这种大规模的数据融合工作......

reflection.en: The news of pervasive high-tech surveillance highlights the vulnerability of individuals when state power becomes absolute. Proverbs 28:15 reminds us that unchecked authority can be like a dangerous predator to a helpless populace. It calls us to reflect on the importance of freedom and the dignity of every person, even in the face of overwhelming systems.
reflection.zh: 普遍存在的高科技监控新闻凸显了当国家权力变得绝对时，个人所面临的脆弱性。箴言28:15提醒我们，不受约束的权力对无助的民众来说，可能像危险的捕食者。它呼吁我们反思自由的重要性以及每个人的尊严，即使面对压倒性的系统。

title.en: Can the Quad stay relevant to boost Indo-Pacific security?
title.zh: 四方安全对话能否保持相关性以促进印太安全？

summary.en: Foreign ministers from the United States, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.
summary.zh: 美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚四国外长——统称为“四方安全对话”——需要搁置过去的分歧，才能使该联盟继续成为对抗中国的有效手段。

body.en:
Foreign ministers from the United States, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.

Foreign ministers from the United States , India, Japan and Australia — the four nations that make up the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, better known as the Quad — are set to meet in New Delhi over three days startng Sunday to discuss Indo-Pacific security, energy supplies and emerging technologies.

The meeting comes as China continues to test geopolitical and security boundaries in the region.

But it's another issue, which is not on the agenda, that looms large over the gathering: how to keep the alliance alive and relevant in an ever more challenging geopolitical landscape and an increasingly assertive China .

The Quad, which unites the four nations in seeking a Free and Open Indo-Pacific (FOIP), has not had a meeting of national leaders since 2024, when then-President Joe Biden hosted his counterparts in Wilmington, Delaware.

India was meant to host the next annual meeting in the latter part of 2025, but that never materialized amid tensions between India and the new administration of President Donald Trump .

Trump has imposed tariffs and punitive duties on Indian imports to the US, straining ties with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The US president further antagonized New Delhi by claiming to have mediated a settlement to border clashes between India and Pakistan in May last year . The US president was also critical of India purchasing Russian military equipment .

One year on, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who is heading the US delegation to India, is tasked with smoothing ruffled diplomatic feathers. With Trump's attention apparently focused on the war in the Middle East and, potentially, Cuba , Rubio's mission could be a challenging one.

"The US, Japan and Australia already had an important and effective trilateral security arrangement, but the whole purpose of the Quad was to bring India in as another power to give it more influence and reach," said James Brown, a professor of international relations at the Tokyo campus of Temple University.

"Unfortunately, this US administration does not seem to have grasped that or valued India's presence as an ally, which has badly alienated Modi," he told DW.

Japan and Australia have made efforts to keep the four-way alliance intact and functioning, with Brown suggesting that the Quad might actually benefit from the US being represented by Rubio, rather than Trump, in India.

body.zh: 如果该联盟要继续成为对抗中国的有效手段，美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚（统称为“四方”）的外交部长就需要将过去的分歧抛在脑后。 来自美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚这四个国家的外交部长将于周日开始在新德里举行为期三天的会议，讨论印太安全、能源供应和新兴技术。 这次会议召开之际，中国正在继续测试该地区的地缘政治和安全边界。 但另一个未列入议程的问题在这次会议上显得尤为突出：如何在日益具有挑战性的地缘政治格局和日益自信的中国中保持联盟的活力和相关性。 四方联盟将四个国家团结起来，寻求自由开放的印度太平洋地区 (FOIP)，自 2024 年时任总统乔·拜登在特拉华州威尔明顿接待各国领导人以来，该组织就没有举行过国家领导人会议。 印度原定于 2025 年下半年主办下一次年度会议，但由于印度与唐纳德·特朗普总统新政府之间的紧张关系，这一目标从未实现。 特朗普对印度输美产品征收关税和惩罚性关税，导致与印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的关系紧张。这位美国总统去年五月声称已通过调解解决了印度和巴基斯坦之间的边境冲突，这进一步激怒了新德里。美国总统还批评印度购买俄罗斯军事装备。 一年后，率领美国代表团访问印度的国务卿马可·卢比奥肩负着平息外交争端的任务。由于特朗普的注意力显然集中在中东战争以及可能的古巴战争上，卢比奥的任务可能是一项具有挑战性的任务。 天普大学东京校区国际关系学教授詹姆斯·布朗表示：“美国、日本和澳大利亚已经达成了重要且有效的三边安全安排，但四方机制的全部目的是让印度成为另一个大国，以赋予其更大的影响力和影响力。” 他告诉德国之声：“不幸的是，本届美国政府似乎没有认识到这一点，也没有重视印度作为盟友的存在，这严重疏远了莫迪。” 日本和澳大利亚一直在努力保持四方联盟的完整和运作，布朗表示，四方联盟实际上可能会受益于卢比奥而不是特朗普在印度代表美国。 南加州大学教授德里克·格罗斯曼在《外交政策》杂志上撰文警告说，如果特朗普拒绝参加下一次领导人会议，可能会……

reflection.en: The Quad alliance's effectiveness in boosting regional security hinges on its members overcoming past differences and working together. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that where there is an abundance of wise counsel, there is safety. For nations, as for individuals, unity in purpose among leaders can lead to greater stability and protection for all.
reflection.zh: 四方安全对话联盟能否有效促进地区安全，取决于其成员能否克服过去的分歧并通力合作。箴言11:14提醒我们，谋士众多，人便安居。对国家而言，如同对个人一样，领导者目标一致，能为所有人带来更大的稳定和保护。
